fragments.text: First Depositor Inflation Attack on gHYBR
## Finding description and impact

The first depositor into GovernanceHYBR (gHYBR) can manipulate the share price by directly inflating totalAssets() without minting shares. This causes subsequent depositors to receive 0 shares while losing their entire deposit.
Root Cause: No protection against share price manipulation via direct asset inflation.
File: ve33/contracts/GovernanceHYBR.sol (Lines 232-239)
key formular : shares = (depositAmount × totalSupply) / totalAssets
totalAssets() reads from the veNFT's locked amount, which can be increased by ANYONE calling IVotingEscrow.deposit_for(veTokenId, amount) directly!
Attacker Makes Minimal First Deposit
Attacker calls: gHYBR.deposit(1, attacker) with 1 wei
File: ve33/contracts/GovernanceHYBR.sol (Lines 124-153)
gHYBR totalSupply: 1 wei
veNFT locked amount: 1 wei
totalAssets(): 1 wei
Attacker's shares: 1 wei
Share price: 1 wei HYBR per 1 wei share (1:1 ratio)
Attacker Inflates totalAssets WITHOUT Minting Shares
This is the KEY EXPLOIT STEP!
The attacker directly calls VotingEscrow.deposit_for() to add HYBR to the veNFT:
File: ve33/contracts/VotingEscrow.sol (Lines 821-835)
impact :Attacker deposits 1 wei, inflates share price, and steals 100% of ALL subsequent deposits
